notes.title: Update 1.3 (Birb Drag!)
notes.content:
[b][Update v1.3][/b]
[b][Added][/b]
- Birb Drag!

[b][Changed][/b]
- Reworked how new investments are unlocked in Birb Empire.

[b][Fixed][/b]
- General bug fixes.

notes.title: Hotfix + SFX
notes.content:
[b][Small Patch][/b]
- Fixed a few bugs in Racing
- Added additional SFX to UI Buttons in Menus including Birb Empire.

[b][Notes][/b]
- Birb Drag will be released later this month.

notes.title: Update 1.2 (The Visual Update)
notes.content:
[b][Changed][/b]
- Graphics Overhauled for Walk Training, Climb Training,
    and Birb Race.
- Greatly improved performance in Walk, Climb, and 
   Glide Training.
- Camera no longer zooms out in Walk Training.
- Reworked Birb Empire.

notes.title: Update 1.1 (The UI Update)
notes.content:
[b][Changed][/b]
- Complete UI overhaul
- Birb Empire overhauled
- Increased overall performance
- Revamped auto-save function

[b][Added][/b]
- Full screen and Windowed toggle in settings
- Highscores panel to main menu
- (What's new) Update window to main menu
- Blue birb animation to main menu
- Are you sure windows to training games when restarting or returning home
- Birb Drag button to main menu (coming soon)
- x64 XP rate to all training games, also time between multipliers shortened

[b][Fixed][/b]
- Walk Training double death
- Jump and fall SFX playing at start of walk training
- No longer fall beneath map when you fall through platform too quickly in Walk Training
